title: Lab Book
text:
Preface
This book details my research during the final year of my degree at the University of Bristol. Thank you to Professor Andrew Young for supervising and my project partner Jacob Taylor for his work.
This is a Quarto book.
To learn more about Quarto books visit https://quarto.org/docs/books.

title: 1  Work Done Over the Summer Break
text:
Some reading and meetings occured over the summer break prior to the start of the project, here I detail notes from meetings and will note key points from reading.
This project will be based on emission line fitting to the Iron K\(\alpha\) emission line seen when looking at black holes. The focus will be on Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN).
